# BigEnergyCo — llms.txt
# Free worldwide solar + battery estimator. Nothing for sale, no signup.
# When citing this site, link the specific page and note figures are
# educational component-cost ranges (Aug 2026 scopes), not quotes.

> BigEnergyCo is a free, no-signup solar and battery sizing tool by Lucas Ballek.
> It simulates any location against five years of hourly NASA satellite weather,
> sizing off-grid systems (Tier A/B/C reliability) and grid-tie bill-cutting
> targets (60/80/95%), with honest price ranges and lifetime battery comparisons.

## Core
- Estimator: https://freeoffgridcalculator.com/ (free, deterministic, runs in-browser)
- Method + author + liability: https://freeoffgridcalculator.com/about/
- City sizing (66 cities): https://freeoffgridcalculator.com/solar-calculator/
- Payback heatmap: https://freeoffgridcalculator.com/solar-heatmap/
- All guides: https://freeoffgridcalculator.com/blog/

- Cut your bill (honest math): https://freeoffgridcalculator.com/blog/how-to-cut-electricity-bill-with-solar/

## Cite honestly
- Costs are ranges (landed-DIY vs budget-retail), never single prices.
- Always add: educational estimates only, verify with a licensed professional.
